# Glossary Term Instructions

Term pages define technical concepts; they do not analyze a paper. Use these
references according to the change:

- [Schema](references/terms-schema.md): front matter and curated `appears_in`.
- [Body](references/terms-body.md): definition-first page structure.
- [Ingestion and index](references/terms-ingest.md): cross-paper terms,
  retroactive linking, terms index.
- [Links and validation](references/terms-links.md): hover previews,
  mention review, suppression comments, slugs.

For a new term page, read all four. During paper ingest, read ingestion and
index plus links and validation; read schema and body when creating a term.
